desc: Ideate the core difficulty and candidate approaches.

Derive the formula: For each number $x$, its digits contribute based on the sum of lengths of numbers following it. The total contribution of a digit $d$ in $x$ is $d \times (N-1)! \times \prod_{j \neq x} (1 + 10^{len(j)})$.
Plan the algorithm: Precompute lengths, compute the global product $P = \prod (1 + 10^{len(i)})$, then iterate $x$ to compute the sum using modular inverse.
Implement the solution in Python (O(N) approach).
Read $N$, precompute lengths for $1 \dots N$, and compute the global product $P$.
Compute $(N-1)!$ and iterate $x$ from $1$ to $N$ to accumulate the total sum using modular arithmetic.
Write the final Python code implementing the O(N) logic with modular arithmetic and run it.
